text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"—What colors race history is not solely 
the brilliance of 'intense individuality.' 
In history, there exist countless fervent 
'rivalries.'"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Are you... finished already?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I was just planning to take an 
interval break... Please excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I see... Then, fifty more reps...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... When a girl like that is beside 
me... goodness! I mustn't... I have to... 
hold back...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
As I thought... they seem quite conscious 
of each other...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Their feelings for one another... Just 
what lies in the depths of their 
hearts...? I would love nothing more than 
to interview them...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —An interview? I have no time for that.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I, too, um... While it is an honor... 
baring the contents of my heart is 
just............

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a refusal... is it... I understand... 
I apologize for asking so suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um, in that case...! Could I please... 
just observe? I promise I will not get in 
your way...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Observe, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Surely you don't need permission just for 
that, do you? There's always someone on 
the course anyway.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... It is not something we could 
stop you from doing.

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"—The training of the two crown 
candidates... The way they honed 
themselves to match their respective 
individuality was utterly captivating—"

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"—In the profiles of these powerhouses, 
sometimes fiery, sometimes astonishing, 
was packed the very secret to their 
strength!"

One day, I spotted Chrono Genesis calling 
out to some horse girls after their 
training. It seemed to be for the school 
newspaper interview.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for your hard work today as 
well...! Um, these are... refreshments for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... you always bring something. Even 
though you already timed our laps earlier.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No, I simply wished to be of help. ...Even 
so, the running of you two was truly 
overwhelming...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You really never get tired of this, day 
after day...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
No matter how kind you are to us... I 
cannot meet your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... could it be you mean the 
interview...? No, no, that was not my 
intention at all...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To have the precious opportunity to 
observe such accomplished powerhouses up 
close...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Both as a racing writer and as a horse 
girl aspiring toward the Tiara path, it is 
an immense honor...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Right now... I might be witnessing the 
very moment history is being born...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
When I think of that, my gratitude knows 
no bounds... In other words, this is 
merely an 'expression of thanks'... So 
please, think nothing of it...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...It has reached me. Your... wholehearted 
devotion to race history.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You truly... just love racing, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...So? What is it you want to ask? For the 
interview.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu... I shall accept as well.

It seemed Chrono Genesis had managed to 
secure interviews with the subjects of her 
desires. The feeling of hers that moved 
the two was truly—

secure interviews with the subjects of her 
desires. The feeling of hers that moved 
the two was truly—
choice_data_list: That's a deep love of racing.
That's a deep love of racing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Love...? What use could such a thing 
possibly have?
choice_data_list: That's a deep love of racing.
That's a deep love of racing.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It does not have to be useful... and that 
is fine. As someone who loves racing... 
that is what I believe... if I may be so 
bold.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If it is love like this, no matter how 
deep, it is truly wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: How enviable...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...? I-I am humbled... If it is only the 
depth of love for racing... well... I do 
possess confidence in that...
